description: This file contains the implementation of the AuthSchemeResolver class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes logic for resolving and selecting authentication schemes for AWS services based on configuration, identity, and environment compatibility.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolver
classes.description: Handles selection and validation of authentication schemes for AWS SDK service requests.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects an appropriate authentication scheme based on priorities, identity, and environment.

methods.name: isCompatibleAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks compatibility of an auth scheme with current environment and credentials.

methods.name: getIncompatibilityMessage
methods.description: Provides message explaining why an auth scheme isn't compatible.

methods.name: hasAwsCredentialIdentity
methods.description: Checks whether valid AWS credentials are available.

methods.name: hasBearerTokenIdentity
methods.description: Checks whether a bearer token identity is available.
